text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Yamanin Zephyr, medium distance was a 
stretch. Yet, spurred on by her Trainer's 
cheers, she mustered her final ounce of 
strength toward the supreme realm—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside Symboli Rudolf, the 
Umamusume murmured, "You are the true 
wind..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr won the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
She brilliantly achieved the 
"Three-Division Sweep," something even the 
"Emperor of the Mile" never reached.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Tokai Teio was undergoing 
rehabilitation. Frustrated that someone 
had surpassed the "Emperor" before her, 
she swore to make a miraculous comeback at 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr achieved her goal. However, 
she was not satisfied yet. Seeking an even 
stronger, freer wind, she keeps on 
running.
